rule: Amazonas municipalities that keep Acre time (UTC-5, two hours behind Brasilia; Decreto 2.784/1913 as amended by Lei 12.876/2013, the Tabatinga-Porto Acre line); every other Amazonas municipality keeps UTC-4. Voting closes at 15:00 local in these and 16:00 local elsewhere in Amazonas.
codes: TSE municipality codes; names and zones checked against TSE eleitorado_local_votacao 2022 and 2026 (AM)

sources.title: TRE-AM, Eleitorado do Amazonas deve ficar atento aos horários de votação nas Eleições 2026

urn_evidence: Configured closing times printed by the urns (semantic pass v3): every Amazonas municipality that printed 15:00 is on the list and none on the list printed 16:00, in 2022 and 2026; 10 of the 11 printed in 2026 and 9 in 2022.
